purpose: Enforce the Layer 27 operation-policy model at the HTTP front door for every privileged POST route before route-specific authentication and atomic execution guards.

policyStates.admit: Continue to normal route authentication and the existing atomic/service guard.
policyStates.admit-degraded: Continue while preserving degraded dependency semantics in the operation policy result.
policyStates.worker-only: Continue to the existing authenticated worker path.
policyStates.deny: Return HTTP 403 before the route service executes.
policyStates.unavailable: Return HTTP 503 before the route service executes.
policyStates.not-registered: Allow the handler to continue to its normal routing result, normally 404 for an unknown POST path.
